svg.title: One storefront, three clouds
svg.text: The same shop built three times. Read path in blue, checkout (write) path in orange, async order events in purple.
1 Shopper traffic hits the edge (CDN + WAF), then a regional load balancer. 2 Services run as pods in a managed Kubernetes cluster. 3 Reads come from cache, search and the cart store.
4 Checkout writes the order to the relational database and publishes an event. 5 Functions send emails, invoices and stock updates from the queue, outside the shopper's request.
